title: The Black Lamb
subtitle: It's better to flee into the wilderness than to return to a cold flock.

trails.title: Paths of the Past - Anjo Nala

content.text: An intercepted telegram, secrets revealed. Another bullet casing left on the execution ground.

items.text: The Black Lamb
Sao Paulo Veterans' Residence
The pieces are falling into place. Lopera has gone to the colonel's manor, as Admiral Igor planned.
If Mr. Duncan moves quickly, he might make it to the manor in time to meet her.
The early morning sun scorches the courtyard.
White Rum is still tucked away in her bottle, fast asleep.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: What are you waiting for?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Admiral Igor has sent reinforcements. We were instructed to await their arrival at this location.
Some time has passed. The sun has now risen well into the sky, but the reinforcements are yet to arrive.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: Igor?
She tenses up at the name.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Do you know him?

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: N-No, I don't. And I don't want to know him, either. I want nothing to do with those Zeno madmen!
She knows him. She's hiding something.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: Stay away from them, Vertin. Trust me, they—
They're here.
A young man with an eye patch strides into the Veterans' Residence, followed by a squad of soldiers, all armed to the teeth.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Greetings, Timekeeper of the St. Pavlov Foundation. I'm Ptolemy, the Commander of Igor's Sentinel Unit.
Ptolemy? No one at the base has mentioned such a name before.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Are we setting off now, Commander Ptolemy?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Setting off? No, no. It's Lopera's mission to take care of the doctor.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: My mission, well ... It concerns the young lady behind you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I wasn't informed of this. What does she have to do with Zeno?
Is it because of what happened at Tuesday's Motel?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: As far as I'm aware, the Zeno officer at Tuesday's Motel committed suicide. Kimberly had nothing to do with it.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Oh, Stefen? I couldn't care less about him.
If that's the case, then why is he here?

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: The door opened all by itself.
What door?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Hmph. I'm not stupid, you know. Ms. Kimberly somehow escapes the base.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: And suddenly I find her with the Timekeeper, who I hear took a detour to a certain tower before she left.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: So, Timekeeper, care to explain why you helped Ms. Kimberly, a member of Manus Vindictae, escape?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh, so the captive in that tower was Ms. Kimberly?
She gives him no answer.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Per the admiral's orders, I will now escort you back to the base, Ms. Kimberly. And please, don't make me resort to violence.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: No. I'm not going back there.
She takes a step back, her body trembling all over. She's too frightened to run.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: You'll kill me, just like those Zeno soldiers.
Ptolemy's soldiers raise their guns, just as the others did when they executed the deserters.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Now, now. Let's just get along, shall we?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: This isn't an arrest, Ms. Kimberly. It's an invitation.
He reaches into his pocket and reveals Zeno's "sincerity."

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: A succubus should follow her instincts.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Come on. Obey your master.
A toy. Unremarkable, even ridiculous, yet utterly terrifying to her.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: You know, you were close, Kimberly. You almost found it.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: It was hidden at Tuesday's Motel, just like you thought. Stefen thought it was just a wind-up toy. Hmph. What a fool.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: Give it back!

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Yes, that's the spirit. Come with me, and I'll—

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Don't. He's not going to give it back to you.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Oh, so you'd rather stay with the Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: I guess you need a little reminder of who your real master is.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Soldiers, prepare to fire!
Kimberly barely moves as she struggles against the command of the seal. Meanwhile, Ptolemy and his troops have taken control of the courtyard.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Pick it up, Timekeeper.
He's tossed a pistol near her.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: I hold no grudge against you, and I'm not going to shoot an unarmed civilian.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Make your choice. Take the weapon and continue to fight, or surrender.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: If you do surrender, I'll guarantee your freedom, but Kimberly has to come with us.
She picks up the pistol.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: I see. So you've chosen to fight. On your feet.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Now then, Kimberly.
The officer gives a malicious grin.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Kill her.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: You want me to kill Vertin?
A command as malicious as the look on his face.
She doesn't know what to do.
But her bloodline allows her no choice. The seal takes effect, slowly compelling her to obey it.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Come on, my patience has its limits.
Ptolemy raises the wind-up toy, like a lighthouse beacon in a storm.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: You will obey me!
Compulsion. An attack so swift that there is no time to react.
The succubus looms over, her eyes hollow, her beastly claw poised to strike.
Ptolemy will say anything to ensure she enacts his will.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Do it, demon. Your freedom for the life of a stranger.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Yes, kill her. Prove your loyalty. Then I'll give you back your toy, I promise.
The succubus wraps her claws around her neck.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: Vertin ... I ... I can't ...
The command has taken hold of her, but still, she's wavering.
Meanwhile, Ptolemy, like a sadistic spectator in a coliseum, wills their struggle to go on.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Raise your gun, Timekeeper.
Gun ... yes ... I have a gun ...
But breathing ... strength ... it's all ...

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Aim at her and pull the trigger.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: This monster's going to kill you. You'll have to shoot her if you want to live.
Ptolemy presses further, eager to get a show.
No matter how hard she resists, the succubus within her must obey.
Her claws tighten around her neck. She can hardly breathe.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: No, I don't ...
Her struggle is as futile as her tears.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Obey your master.
Her claws start to sink into her neck.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Yes. Give in. Just like that.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Look, Kimberly. She picked up the gun. Shouldn't you kill her before she kills you?

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: She obviously values her own life over yours, and she won't hesitate to fire a bullet through your heart. To her, you're just a horrifying beast.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: I mean, look at you. You're a succubus, a demon born to be bound to a master! Born to be controlled!
His contempt is palpable.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: No! I-I don't want to!!
She's pleading.
Tears pour down her cheeks.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: Please. No more orders. No more running. No more.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: I don't want to be like my sister.
Hiding away for all those years, living no kind of life at all, only to be captured and executed.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: If that's what you want, then kill her. Break her neck.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Now, heed my order and kill Vertin!
She does everything she can to resist the command, yet her body is compelled to follow.
She raises a claw. It hangs in the air, like a butcher's knife ready to slice its meat.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: End your suffering with her death.

items.speaker: Ptolemy
items.text: Don't think. Just obey.
Her grip tightens.
The pistol ... Get it. There's still a chance.

items.speaker: Anjo Nala
items.text: L-Let go. Let go of her.
She's sobbing.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Nala ...
Aim ... at him ...
TO BE CONTINUED…
